question: Must this Android lifecycle fix include an emulator or physical-device process-death recovery run before merge, or will maintainers explicitly accept the Robolectric-only evidence?
rationale: The source and simulated tests strongly support the fix, but the repository requires external PRs to demonstrate changed behavior in a real setup, and only an Android owner can accept the remaining platform-specific availability risk.

options.title: Require real Android proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted emulator or device run showing process death, sticky restart, reconnect, and terminal STOP on the current head.

options.title: Accept simulated evidence
options.body: Explicitly waive the real-behavior gate after Android owner review and focused CI complete.

recommendation.title: Require real Android proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted emulator or device run showing process death, sticky restart, reconnect, and terminal STOP on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current service/runtime behavior, is assigned to this PR, and authored the head-refresh commits.
